ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The circuit in the attached figure uses the bottom wire as the common reference node. On the left is a 5 V independent voltage source, whose upper terminal is connected through a 250 Ω resistor to the middle top node; the two ends of this 250 Ω resistor are labeled +V_R−, so according to the polarity in the figure, V_R = 5 - v, where v is the middle top node voltage. From the middle top node to ground there is a dependent current source, with arrow downward, and the current is labeled V_R/500; a 250 Ω resistor to ground is also connected in parallel. The right side is connected through a switch that closes at t=0 to a 0.6 μF capacitor, with capacitor voltage v_c(t) positive at the top and negative at the bottom. Then reason: After the switch closes, the capacitor port sees the Thevenin equivalent of the left network. First find the open-circuit voltage V_th, let the port voltage be v, and V_R = 5 - v. Write KCL at the middle top node: the current through the left 250 Ω resistor is (v-5)/250, the current through the vertical 250 Ω resistor is v/250, and the downward current of the dependent source is (5-v)/500. Therefore (v-5)/250 + v/250 + (5-v)/500 = 0. Multiplying by 500 gives 2v - 10 + 2v + 5 - v = 0, that is, 3v - 5 = 0, so V_th = v = 5/3 V. When finding R_th, set the 5 V independent source to zero, that is, short-circuit the left voltage source. Apply a test voltage v_x to the port; then in the figure V_R = 0 - v_x = -v_x. The current entering the network from the port is i_x = v_x/250 + v_x/250 + (-v_x)/500 = 3v_x/500. Therefore the equivalent conductance is 3/500 S, and R_th = v_x/i_x = 500/3 Ω. The time constant τ = R_th C = (500/3)(0.6 μF) = 100 μs = 0.1 ms. The initial capacitor value is given by the problem as v_c(0) = -5 V, and the final value is V_th = 5/3 V, so v_c(t) = 5/3 + (-5 - 5/3)e^{-t/0.1 ms} = 5/3 - (20/3)e^{-t/0.1 ms}. Let v_c(t)=0, giving (20/3)e^{-t/0.1 ms}=5/3, therefore e^{-t/0.1 ms}=1/4. Thus t = 0.1 ln 4 ms = 0.138629... ms, rounded to three decimal places as 0.139 ms.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the capacitor port as the top node after the switch and the bottom rail as reference. Let the open-circuit port voltage be v. With VR=5−v, apply KCL at the node without the capacitor to find Vth; this gives Vth=5/3 V. To find Rth, zero the 5 V source, apply a test voltage vx at the port, note VR=0−vx=−vx, and sum the currents drawn by the network to get the equivalent conductance; this yields Rth=500/3 Ω. With C=0.6 μF from the image and vc(0)=−5 V from the text, use vc(t)=5/3+(−5−5/3)e^{-t/[(500/3)(0.6 μF)]}. Set vc(t)=0, giving e^{-t/0.1 ms}=1/4 and t=0.1 ln 4 ms≈0.139 ms.

先描述图像：附图中的电路以底部导线为公共参考节点。左侧是一个 5 V 独立电压源，其上端通过一个 250 Ω 电阻接到中间顶节点；该 250 Ω 电阻两端标有 +V_R−，所以按图中极性 V_R = 5 - v，其中 v 是中间顶节点电压。中间顶节点到地有一个受控电流源，箭头向下，电流标为 V_R/500；还并联一个 250 Ω 电阻到地。右侧通过 t=0 闭合的开关连接到一个 0.6 μF 电容，电容电压 v_c(t) 上正下负。

再推理：闭合开关后，电容端口看到左侧网络的戴维南等效。先求开路电压 V_th，令端口电压为 v，且 V_R = 5 - v。对中间顶节点列 KCL：通过左侧 250 Ω 电阻的电流为 (v-5)/250，通过竖直 250 Ω 电阻的电流为 v/250，受控源向下电流为 (5-v)/500。因此 (v-5)/250 + v/250 + (5-v)/500 = 0。乘以 500 得 2v - 10 + 2v + 5 - v = 0，即 3v - 5 = 0，所以 V_th = v = 5/3 V。

求 R_th 时，将 5 V 独立源置零，即左侧电压源短路。对端口加测试电压 v_x，则图中 V_R = 0 - v_x = -v_x。端口流入网络的电流为 i_x = v_x/250 + v_x/250 + (-v_x)/500 = 3v_x/500。因此等效电导为 3/500 S，R_th = v_x/i_x = 500/3 Ω。

时间常数 τ = R_th C = (500/3)(0.6 μF) = 100 μs = 0.1 ms。电容初值由题给为 v_c(0) = -5 V，终值为 V_th = 5/3 V，所以 v_c(t) = 5/3 + (-5 - 5/3)e^{-t/0.1 ms} = 5/3 - (20/3)e^{-t/0.1 ms}。令 v_c(t)=0，得到 (20/3)e^{-t/0.1 ms}=5/3，因此 e^{-t/0.1 ms}=1/4。于是 t = 0.1 ln 4 ms = 0.138629... ms，四舍五入到三位小数为 0.139 ms。

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个 5 V 电压源，其上端为正、下端为负；电压源上端通过一个 250 Ω 电阻连接到上方主节点。该 250 Ω 电阻两端标有 +VR−，因此从图中极性可读出 VR = 5 − v，其中 v 是开关闭合后电容上端节点相对下方公共节点的电压。中间有一个向下的受控电流源，标注为 VR/500；另有一个 250 Ω 电阻从同一上方节点接到下方公共节点。右侧开关在 t = 0 闭合后，把该上方节点连接到电容上端；电容为 0.6 μF，电容电压 vc(t) 上正下负。下方导线为公共参考节点。推理：开关闭合后，取下方公共导线为地，令节点电压 v = vc(t)。按指定方法写从该节点离开的电流：经左侧 250 Ω 电阻为 (v − 5)/250，经竖直 250 Ω 电阻为 v/250，受控电流源向下电流为 VR/500 = (5 − v)/500，电容电流为 C dv/dt，且 C = 0.6 μF。由 KCL 得 C dv/dt + (v − 5)/250 + v/250 + (5 − v)/500 = 0。合并电阻/电流源项：乘以 500 后为 2(v − 5) + 2v + (5 − v) = 3v − 5，所以微分方程为 C dv/dt + (3v − 5)/500 = 0。其稳态终值满足 3v − 5 = 0，即 v(∞) = 5/3 V；时间常数 τ = 500C/3 = 500(0.6 μF)/3 = 0.1 ms。初值由题给 vc(0) = −5 V，因此 v(t) = 5/3 + (−5 − 5/3)e^(−t/τ) = 5/3 − (20/3)e^(−t/0.1 ms)。令 v(t) = 0，则 0 = 5/3 − (20/3)e^(−t/0.1 ms)，所以 e^(−t/0.1 ms) = 1/4，t = 0.1 ln 4 ms = 0.138629... ms，四舍五入到三位小数为 0.139 ms。

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个 5 V 电压源，其上端为正、下端为负；电压源上端通过一个 250 Ω 电阻连接到上方主节点。该 250 Ω 电阻两端标有 +VR−，因此从图中极性可读出 VR = 5 − v，其中 v 是开关闭合后电容上端节点相对下方公共节点的电压。中间有一个向下的受控电流源，标注为 VR/500；另有一个 250 Ω 电阻从同一上方节点接到下方公共节点。右侧开关在 t = 0 闭合后，把该上方节点连接到电容上端；电容为 0.6 μF，电容电压 vc(t) 上正下负。下方导线为公共参考节点。推理：开关闭合后，取下方公共导线为地，令节点电压 v = vc(t)。按指定方法写从该节点离开的电流：经左侧 250 Ω 电阻为 (v − 5)/250，经竖直 250 Ω 电阻为 v/250，受控电流源向下电流为 VR/500 = (5 − v)/500，电容电流为 C dv/dt，且 C = 0.6 μF。由 KCL 得 C dv/dt + (v − 5)/250 + v/250 + (5 − v)/500 = 0。合并电阻/电流源项：乘以 500 后为 2(v − 5) + 2v + (5 − v) = 3v − 5，所以微分方程为 C dv/dt + (3v − 5)/500 = 0。其稳态终值满足 3v − 5 = 0，即 v(∞) = 5/3 V；时间常数 τ = 500C/3 = 500(0.6 μF)/3 = 0.1 ms。初值由题给 vc(0) = −5 V，因此 v(t) = 5/3 + (−5 − 5/3)e^(−t/τ) = 5/3 − (20/3)e^(−t/0.1 ms)。令 v(t) = 0，则 0 = 5/3 − (20/3)e^(−t/0.1 ms)，所以 e^(−t/0.1 ms) = 1/4，t = 0.1 ln 4 ms = 0.138629... ms，四舍五入到三位小数为 0.139 ms。

raw_record.original_question: In the circuit shown in the figure, the switch is closed at time \(t = 0\), while the capacitor is initially charged to \(-5\,\text{V}\) (i.e., \(v_c(0) = -5\,\text{V}\)). The time after which the voltage across the capacitor becomes zero, rounded off to three decimal places, is ________ ms.
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: The circuit in the attached figure uses the bottom wire as the common reference node. On the left is a 5 V independent voltage source, whose upper terminal is connected through a 250 Ω resistor to the middle top node; the two ends of this 250 Ω resistor are labeled +V_R−, so according to the polarity in the figure, V_R = 5 - v, where v is the middle top node voltage. From the middle top node to ground there is a dependent current source, with arrow downward, and the current is labeled V_R/500; a 250 Ω resistor to ground is also connected in parallel. The right side is connected through a switch that closes at t=0 to a 0.6 μF capacitor, with capacitor voltage v_c(t) positive at the top and negative at the bottom.

Then reason: After the switch closes, the capacitor port sees the Thevenin equivalent of the left network. First find the open-circuit voltage V_th, let the port voltage be v, and V_R = 5 - v. Write KCL at the middle top node: the current through the left 250 Ω resistor is (v-5)/250, the current through the vertical 250 Ω resistor is v/250, and the downward current of the dependent source is (5-v)/500. Therefore (v-5)/250 + v/250 + (5-v)/500 = 0. Multiplying by 500 gives 2v - 10 + 2v + 5 - v = 0, that is, 3v - 5 = 0, so V_th = v = 5/3 V.

When finding R_th, set the 5 V independent source to zero, that is, short-circuit the left voltage source. Apply a test voltage v_x to the port; then in the figure V_R = 0 - v_x = -v_x. The current entering the network from the port is i_x = v_x/250 + v_x/250 + (-v_x)/500 = 3v_x/500. Therefore the equivalent conductance is 3/500 S, and R_th = v_x/i_x = 500/3 Ω.

The time constant τ = R_th C = (500/3)(0.6 μF) = 100 μs = 0.1 ms. The initial capacitor value is given by the problem as v_c(0) = -5 V, and the final value is V_th = 5/3 V, so v_c(t) = 5/3 + (-5 - 5/3)e^{-t/0.1 ms} = 5/3 - (20/3)e^{-t/0.1 ms}. Let v_c(t)=0, giving (20/3)e^{-t/0.1 ms}=5/3, therefore e^{-t/0.1 ms}=1/4. Thus t = 0.1 ln 4 ms = 0.138629... ms, rounded to three decimal places as 0.139 ms.
